_comment: Hooks use `python`, not `python3`. Python 2 is 6+ years past EOL; on every major platform in 2026 `python` is Python 3. session_start.py checks the version at session start as a safety net. CI (gate.yml) uses `python3` explicitly because ubuntu-latest guarantees it.

PreToolUse._comment: The hole in v1: enforcement covered Bash only, so the agent could edit its own tests to make them pass, and edit its own hooks to stop being governed.

Notification._comment: Fires when the agent needs permission or input. This is the gate reaching your phone at 3am instead of the run idling until morning.
